cards.title: Honey keeps
cards.text: Properly sealed honey can last for centuries: its low water content and acidity make it hostile to microbes. Edible honey has been reported in ancient Egyptian tombs.

cards.title: QWERTY
cards.text: The QWERTY keyboard layout was designed for 1870s typewriters and has stuck around ever since, despite many proposed alternatives.

cards.title: Botany is weird
cards.text: Botanically, bananas are berries, while strawberries are not: a strawberry's 'seeds' are actually tiny individual fruits.

cards.statement: Different parts of the tongue detect different tastes.
cards.explanation: The 'tongue map' came from a misreading of a 1901 paper; all taste areas sense all basic tastes.

cards.statement: Hair and nails keep growing after death.
cards.explanation: The skin dehydrates and retracts, which makes hair and nails look longer.

cards.statement: Bulls are enraged by the colour red.
cards.explanation: Cattle are red–green colour-blind; bulls react to the movement of the cape.
